function.name: login_user
function.description: Authenticates student using university credentials Returns true or false for login success or failure.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

function.name: logout_user
function.description: Terminates student session Returns true always because logout is successful.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

function.name: enroll_course
function.description: Enrolls student in specified course Returns true or false based on successful course enrollment.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

function.name: drop_course
function.description: Withdraws student from enrolled course Returns true or false based on successful course removal.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

function.name: request_graduation
function.description: Initiates graduation application process Returns true or false based on successful graduation.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

function.name: apply_financial_aid
function.description: Submits financial assistance application Returns true or false based on application submission status.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

function.name: change_major
function.description: Updates student's declared academic program Returns true or false based on successful major update.

username.description: A string representing the student's unique identifier in the system

new_major.description: Name of the academic major program to switch to

function.name: declare_minor
function.description: Adds secondary academic specialization Returns true or false based on successful minor declaration.
